task_categories.name: Create Content
task_categories.description: Writing blogs, articles, social media posts, newsletters, product descriptions, press releases, whitepapers

examples.prompt: Write a blog post about AI.
Create a detailed technical blog post about machine learning algorithms for software engineers.
Write a 2000-word whitepaper on distributed systems architecture including CAP theorem, consensus algorithms, and real-world tradeoffs. Target: senior architects.
Write a LinkedIn post about our company's new product launch.
Create a weekly newsletter for data scientists with industry news, tool spotlights, and research summaries.
Write product descriptions for 5 SaaS offerings targeting different buyer personas (SMB, mid-market, enterprise).
Draft a press release about a company acquisition.
Create social media content calendar for Q4 2025 with 60 posts across Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram.
Write FAQ page for a new product feature.
Compose email marketing sequence (5 emails) for SaaS free trial onboarding.
Create 10 unique value propositions for different market segments.
Write a comprehensive SEO-optimized guide to microservices architecture.
Draft case study describing customer success story.
Write a short social media caption.
Create a 30-page guide on machine learning deployment best practices.
Write product comparison matrix content for marketing site.
Compose company blog editorial calendar for 2026 with monthly themes and 48 articles.
Create webinar script and slides for 60-minute technical presentation.
Write testimonial/quote prompts for customer interviews.
Draft thought leadership opinion piece on future of AI in enterprise.
Write product feature announcement copy.
Create multi-language marketing content (5 languages) for global launch.
Write a user onboarding tutorial.
Compose customer success story with metrics and quotes.
Write API documentation with code examples.
Create marketing funnel messaging across awareness, consideration, decision stages.
Write employee spotlight article for internal comms.
Draft blog post series outline on 5 related topics.
Write company values and mission statement.
Create comprehensive brand voice and tone guidelines document.
